rationale: PINS the G5 gap: tuple-typed returns ((Int, String)) reference their element types. The return-type collector only matched generic_type/type_identifier/functional_type, so tuple_type returns were silently invisible (the val/var case already matched *_type forms — the function case did not). The edges carry relationshipType return_type with declaredOn tuple_type (the tuple form is distinguishable from ordinary return types for the mutant pin).
